title: After Capacity
subtitle: A Glimpse of Double Descent Life
opener_note: BENCHMARK ASSET with old numbering/title (Chapter 11, Capacity Over Power). Per art-direction README this title mismatch is an open editorial decision — do not silently regenerate; flagged in art-prompts as decision-pending.

slots.anchor: I have been calling the larger philosophy around this **Double Descent Life**
slots.brief: Corner scene: two staircases descending from one landing — one down into orderly machinery halls where robots carry implementation away; the other down into a garden maze with a single human figure pausing at its mouth. The second staircase is the harder one and the drawing knows it.

slots.anchor: reorganized the team around the dropdown menu
slots.brief: Margin vignette: an office whose desks, corridors and org chart have bent themselves into the shape of one giant descending dropdown menu; workers filing neatly into its options. No readable text — the shape carries it.

slots.anchor: ## Learning at the Speed of Curiosity
slots.text: The machines descend into implementation. We descend into meaning.

slots.brief: Margin vignette: a gentle vortex of fragments turning together without merging — a temple column, a laboratory flask, a market stall awning, a parliament bench, a horoscope wheel, a dashboard — all rendered in the same warm palette, none winning.

slots.anchor: It can also be a Ferrari engine attached to bicycle brakes.
slots.brief: Small spot: exactly that — an enormous engine mounted on a modest bicycle, tiny caliper brakes, rider not yet aware. Engineering-drawing deadpan.

slots.anchor: The most hopeful version of the AI future
slots.brief: Corner scene: an evening hillside of many small lit workshops, each window showing a different pursuit — a telescope, a loom, a tiny bakery, a home laboratory, an absurdly specific dashboard lovingly tended by its only user. Room, made visible.
